4. RetroMac

Tagline: Turn your Mac into a time machine.
Description: RetroMac wraps your everyday macOS in the look and feel of classic computers: authentic CRT shaders over your whole screen, themed docks and desktops (Mac OS 9, Windows XP/98, BeOS, Amiga…), retro widgets and games, and a virtual webcam that pipes the CRT look into Zoom, Meet or Teams. Open source, free to use with an optional one-time upgrade for extra presets and webcam support.

Tagline: Tag specialized agents like friends or employees
Description: OpenBot is an open-source, local-first runtime that lets you drop diverse agents into a single workspace and orchestrate them using a clean tag-and-channel system. Fully modular, completely self-contained, and built for developers and makers who want absolute structural control over their agent fleets.
